people.line: I can’t believe I own a home!
You better pay your bills on time!

blocks.text: The scene is frozen in a tableau, and with one tap on the shoulder a character comes to life. In Thought Tracking (also called Tap In), the teacher moves through the tableau and taps students one at a time. Each tapped student says a short line that shows what their character is thinking or feeling in that moment. A still picture turns into a story, and the audience gets a look inside each character’s head.

In our summer vacation tableau, Student A is a teacher candidate who has just bought her first house. Student B is frozen mid-handoff with the keys. Students C and D make a house shape over them. Then the tapping starts:

items: Tap! Student B: “You better pay your bills on time!”
Tap! Student A: “I can’t believe I own a home!”
Tap! Students C and D: “Welcome home!”

blocks.text: In a few seconds, one frozen moment gets characters, feelings and a bit of humour.
